pescador.desc: Peruvian fisherman around 1890 in his 40s, chunky rounded-square head, stubby legs, wide shoulders, warm brown skin, short black hair, wide straw hat with a berry-red band, faded ice-blue work shirt with no tie, rolled stone trousers, dark sandals

walker.desc: Gilbert Walker, British scientist in India in the 1920s, in his 50s, chunky rounded-square head, stubby legs, wide shoulders, pale skin, white hair, white mustache, pale stone-grey linen suit, white shirt, berry-red bow tie, stone trousers, brown shoes

bjerknes.desc: Jacob Bjerknes, Norwegian-American meteorologist in 1969, in his 70s, chunky rounded-square head, stubby legs, wide shoulders, pale rosy skin, thin white hair, dark round glasses, charcoal suit, ice-blue shirt, pine-green tie, charcoal trousers, black shoes
